Priya Nair: quick note: rethinking the relay-vs-delegate handoff for air-gapped installs. want a minimal handshake that covers resume, attestation, and audit.
Diego Alvarez: short list of goals: 1) avoid private key distribution to nodes, 2) allow a single outbound relay to serve constrained sites, 3) enable per-node verification and compact apply records.
Ruth Lin: agree on no node private keys. we should use operator-signed manifests + per-node verifier that posts an apply-record (signed by relay or operator token) back for audit.
Priya Nair: handshake sketch: node requests manifest -> relay responds with manifest + relay_cert -> node validates signatures -> node streams chunk ranges, keeps resume-tokens -> node posts apply-record with resume-tokens + attestation stub.
Diego Alvarez: resume-token model: opaque string per-chunk id + offset. relay keeps a small LRU map to dedupe repeated downloads. relay throttles by token-bucket per-replica-set.
Ruth Lin: attestation: if KMS/HSM present, attach public attestation cert to apply-record. otherwise attach relay-provided proof of fetch (relay_sig).
Priya Nair: failure modes: relay OOM, proxy saturation, partial-apply. operator must expose a deterministic rollback list and GC only after ack.
ops-bot: deploy-check: relay-proto v0.3 passes unit tests :white_check_mark:
Diego Alvarez: next actions: proto for resume-token and apply-record schema (Diego), relay LRU/throttle POC (Priya), compliance list for apply-record (Ruth). RFC draft in 3 days.
Ruth Lin: will include key-rotation and signer-history in the RFC.
Priya Nair: awesome. thanks all.
